programme.desc: Rohana desak Fariz agar berkahwin dengan Rania. Bagaimanapun Fariz menolaknya dan bertegas walau apa cara sekalipun, dia akan tetap berkahwin dengan Ainnura. Dalam waktu yang sama, Ilah berusaha dengan pelbagai cara agar Ainnura tidak rapat dengan Fariz.

programme.title: Scruffts

programme.title: Cute Pets At Home
programme.desc: Brother Hui, who runs an amphibian and reptile store in Xinxing District, Kaohsiung City, has a wide range of knowledge in the field of reptiles. He started with red-eared sliders and gradually got in touch with tortoises, lizards, snakes and other reptile pets. In Brother Hui's brick-and-mortar store, the most special existence is the two store pets, the South American lizards. The male is called Meatball and the female is called Porkball. How did their fate with Brother Hui begin? Brother Hui, who has many years of experience in raising South American lizards, also generously share his breeding secrets. How to distinguish male and female South American lizards? How to keep them healthy? What's the secret to taming them? In this epsiode, we unpack the living environment of South American lizards and reveal the breeding guide!

programme.title: ...Make You Laugh Out Loud
programme.desc: From the funniest feline fails, to the cutest of kittens we've dug out the very best the internet has to offer, and we've the cream of the crop right here.

programme.title: Cute Pet Guide
programme.desc: The meerkat king from "Madagascar" is funny, but meerkats in real life are well-behaved, cuddly and they heal our hearts! Pocket sized pets are currently all the rage, but there are details you need to pay attention to when raising them. For example, hedgehogs are highly defensive, timid sugar gliders will harm themselves without being next to their owners, and cute guinea pigs like Norman from the movie "The Secret Life of Pets" are easily abandoned due to being easy to obtain and raise, etc. Don't worry, experts will teach you how to raise them! Come to a restaurant in Kaohsiung to get up close with Rocket Raccoon from "The Avengers"!

programme.title: Zoo Vet At Large
programme.desc: Dr. Matt gets up close and personal with Albert, Flamingoland's 12-foot alligator, as he moves to a new home. Teddy the pet sheep has suspected calcium deficiency and needs emergency treatment, and Marcel the marmoset leads Matt a merry dance around the surgery. Back at Flamingoland, a reluctant macaw needs his beak trimming -V and Matt comes face-to-face with the new pride of lions.

programme.title: The Dog Rescuers
programme.desc: In a very special festive edition of The Dog Rescuers, Inspector Lyndsey Taylor is called to a case of a desperate dog, left home alone at Christmas. With concern growing for the dog's health, can Lyndsey secure a warrant for police to enter the property in time?

programme.title: Cute Pets At Home
programme.desc: Genus Pterophyllum, commonly known as P. scalare, freshwater angelfish or just angelfish is a large tropical fish native to the Amazon River in South America.They have a laterally flattened body, making them suitableto live in the crevices of tree roots in rivers with smooth water flow, and feeds on aquatic insects. The water temperature should be maintained at 26℃, and should reach 27-28℃ when breeding. The fertilized eggs are then released and attached to water plants or rocks, and the couple will take care of them together. However, once the eggs are hatched, the bigger ones will eat the smaller ones, hence not suitable to be raised together with other small fishes.

programme.desc: Six dogs, six handlers, all competing in the world’s largest and most famous dog show: "Crufts".nnBut they are not the pedigree pooches who compete to be labelled "Best in Show". These are the loveable family pets competing to win the "Scruffts" title.

programme.title: Have A Pet Day
programme.desc: Renowned Golden Bell awarded host Sandy Wu takes her beloved dog Hershey on outings, inviting celebrities and their adorable pets to join in the fun. Beyond exploring nature, the show delves into heartfelt conversations about the journey of pet ownership and shares touching stories amid delightful scenery and cuisine. The program features various enjoyable activities where owners and pets can bond, creating unforgettable memories through laughter and tears.

programme.title: ...Make You Laugh Out Loud
programme.desc: From Christmas as you've never experienced it before, with out-of-tune carol singers, Santa getting stuck, ungrateful children and exploding Christmas puddings - to OAP's, kids and even blundering burglars, six brand spanking new topics are given the trademark LOL treatment, combining user-generated footage with comic narration by comedian Iain Lee. There's a treat too for animal lovers with a Puppies special featuring some of the cutest, as well as funniest, puppy clips on the web.

programme.title: The Dog Rescuers
programme.desc: At an address in the Wirral, Inspector Anthony Joynes finds two collie crosses, Patch and Socks. Both dogs are in very poor condition and Anthony needs to get them out. Inspector Herchy Boal is called to Scooby's rescue. She's collapsed with puncture wounds after fighting with two other dogs. Scooby is in shock so she needs urgent medical care.

programme.title: Best Of Pets
programme.desc: Another episode of Best of Pets with funny pet clips.

programme.title: Cute Pet Guide
programme.desc: SpongeBob's pet is Gary the Snail! Which cute pet has characteristics of both Gary and Mr. Krabs? "Cute Pet Guide" wants to introduce you to these little guys with shells on their backs - hermit crabs: as their bodies grow, they must shed their shells and move to new homes. In addition to that, there are many little-known secrets of them waiting for you to explore!

programme.desc: A single mother must protect her daughter and herself during a heist gone wrong at a high-tech storage facility.

Max’s carefully crafted world seems to be collapsing around him. With his family’s lives on the line, Max is blackmailed by British crime boss, Tommy, to assassinate his best friend, Paul.

Meanwhile, the results of the other tests are coming in. Tim Sanders says the crime scene photos and clippings are authentic, even if they are technically impossible. Brad reports the briefcase is, without a doubt, from the future, made of a super-strong, ultra-light material that will make them both rich beyond their dreams if only J.T. will let him keep it. Carl has emerged from a frantic all-nighter with an unsettling conclusion. Not only does physics indicate that J.T. will die on Friday, but Carl has predicted the universe will be irrevocably damaged if he doesn’t.

programme.title: Dropped - S02:E05 - Saddle Sores
programme.desc: The guys are feeling great as they leave sheep territory, but the 22-hour trip to Tom-Tom, the first moose camp, feels endless. It'll take them two long days of riding to get there. As they head into moose land with a successful sheep packed up high, trouble always seems just around the corner on their journey. After riding for eight hours, issues start cropping up.

programme.title: Dropped - S02:E06 - Church on the Mountain
programme.desc: In the Yukon, decisions can change everything in a heartbeat, especially in such a tough landscape. The brothers are closing in on the enormous mountain grizzly, now just 500 yards away, and it's up to Chris to make the call.

programme.title: Dropped - S02:E07 - Valley of Snow
programme.desc: The Keefer brothers are stuck at Church Camp as the snow keeps pounding down, and they can barely see anything. They're snowed in and don't know when they'll be able to continue their hunting trip. They're starting to face a bunch of problems.

programme.title: Survival Science - S01:E01 - Lost!
programme.desc: Nick and Laura subject themselves to intense survival training with the Survival Training School of California deep in the mountains.

programme.title: Survival Science - S01:E02 - Sniper Science
programme.desc: Nick and Laura explore the variety of skills that military snipers use: marksmanship, long range shooting, detection, stalking, camouflage, infiltration, special reconnaissance and target acquisition.

programme.title: Survival Science - - S01:E03 - Surviving a Bear Attack
programme.desc: Nick and Laura test the power and speed of grizzly bears using Hollywood stunt tools to experience an attack. Also: an attempt to recreate an arrow shot that saved a man from a bear attack.

programme.title: Survival Science - S01:E04 - Surviving a Mountain Lion Attack
programme.desc: Laura and Nick break down the behaviors, strength, eyesight and speed of mountain lions through experiments and explore techniques to deal with these apex predators.

programme.title: Survival Science - S01:E05 - Surviving a Lightning Strike
programme.desc: Laura and Nick determine the power lightning has and how it behaves at a state-of-the-art Direct Effects Lightning Test Lab. They provide advice for hunters and fishermen to protect themselves from it.

programme.title: Fight to Survive - S01:E09 - Leming Bear Attack
programme.desc: The harrowing tale of a father's desperate attempt to save his son's life from a grizzly bear attack while out hunting together.

programme.title: Fight to Survive - S01:E10 - Season Recap
